entries.femaleVariant: Mi serve una persona per un'operazione veloce e silenziosa.
entries.maleVariant: Mi serve una persona per un'operazione veloce e silenziosa.

entries.femaleVariant: È un lavoro per me, non c'è nessun cliente. Perciò mi aspetto un risultato veloce e pulito.
entries.maleVariant: È un lavoro per me, non c'è nessun cliente. Perciò mi aspetto un risultato veloce e pulito.

entries.femaleVariant: Listen.
entries.maleVariant: Listen.

entries.femaleVariant: Sei l'unica a cui lo affiderei.
entries.maleVariant: Sei l'unico a cui lo affiderei.

entries.femaleVariant: Heh. They didn't even make it out of the car.
entries.maleVariant: Heh. They didn't even make it out of the car.

entries.femaleVariant: Shotgun through the glass.
entries.maleVariant: Shotgun through the glass.

entries.femaleVariant: Pow!
entries.maleVariant: Pow!

entries.femaleVariant: Over before anyone on Jig-Jig Street could even scream.
entries.maleVariant: Over before anyone on Jig-Jig Street could even scream.

entries.femaleVariant: Ugh!
entries.maleVariant: Ugh!

entries.femaleVariant: No! Wait! Why?
entries.maleVariant: No! Wait! Why?

entries.femaleVariant: Wakako? She hired me!
entries.maleVariant: Wakako? She hired me!

entries.femaleVariant: No! I got the messages. Her tag, her words, the transfer. Take it. Read it.
entries.maleVariant: No! I got the messages. Her tag, her words, the transfer. Take it. Read it.

entries.femaleVariant: Look for yourself.
entries.maleVariant: Look for yourself.

entries.femaleVariant: Finish it.
entries.maleVariant: Finish it.

entries.femaleVariant: Let him go.
entries.maleVariant: Let him go.

entries.femaleVariant: Connect.
entries.maleVariant: Connect.

entries.femaleVariant: Hand it over.
entries.maleVariant: Hand it over.

entries.femaleVariant: Nova.
entries.maleVariant: Nova.

entries.femaleVariant: Give me half an hour. I'll message you.
entries.maleVariant: Give me half an hour. I'll message you.

entries.femaleVariant: Good, you're in. There's a hardline access point on the wall at the back. Whatever sent those orders went through it.
entries.maleVariant: Good, you're in. There's a hardline access point on the wall at the back. Whatever sent those orders went through it.

entries.femaleVariant: Jack in, breach it, and send me everything it's been carrying.
entries.maleVariant: Jack in, breach it, and send me everything it's been carrying.

entries.femaleVariant: Share what you found with Wakako.
entries.maleVariant: Share what you found with Wakako.

entries.femaleVariant: Sentiamo, allora.
entries.maleVariant: Sentiamo, allora.

entries.femaleVariant: Show her Char's trace.
entries.maleVariant: Show her Char's trace.

entries.femaleVariant: Dev'essere successo qualcosa. Non oserebbe mai contravvenire agli ordini.
entries.maleVariant: Dev'essere successo qualcosa. Non oserebbe mai contravvenire agli ordini.

entries.femaleVariant: Discrezione e finezza.
entries.maleVariant: Discrezione e finezza.

entries.femaleVariant: Sei entrata e te ne sei andata come un fantasma, V.
entries.maleVariant: Sei entrato e te ne sei andato come un fantasma, V.

entries.femaleVariant: Dovevi fare silenzio. Hai fatto tutt'altro.
entries.maleVariant: Dovevi fare silenzio. Hai fatto tutt'altro.

entries.femaleVariant: Lean on the railing and wait for Char.
entries.maleVariant: Lean on the railing and wait for Char.

entries.femaleVariant: Sit down and wait for Char.
entries.maleVariant: Sit down and wait for Char.
